name: tanghulu
description: 糖葫芦：一份持续生长的私人精选

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply tanghulu-db --config wrangler.toml --local
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run content:check && npm run images:check && npm run test:release && npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-db.mjs --remote && wrangler pages deploy dist/pages --project-name tanghulu
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-db.mjs --remote && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
